status: frozen before implementation and held-out evaluation
past_trials: G0-AB and G0-AC0 are pilot data only

learner.calibration: Per policy and cap, minimize development prequential Brier over the same temperature grid, then freeze before heldout. No heldout fitting.

observability: Three independent noisy rank-two local sensors on overlapping coordinate pairs (0,1), (1,2), (2,3). Learners see only raw readings, stable sensor IDs and intervention commands, never state, charts, reset labels or true transports.
dynamics: Hidden arbitrary Mat2(R), left and right SL2 transports. Shared exogenous forward/inverse/rest commands actually change state. Reset at ticks 16 and 32; drift changes transport gradually; dissipation contracts by 0.97; independent replaces state every tick.
structure: Bounded three-slot real recurrent ensemble. Evidence-gated temporary child replaces a slot, stores parent, competes by prequential logscore and can be pruned/restored. This is computational morphology, not physical growth or a change of bundle topology.
remainders: Learned directed rank-two sensor return maps; retain source, target, tick, residual and [R]_transport type. Reset hypotheses use [R]_id. No inferred topological orientation.
prediction_target: Sign of next noise-free sensor-0 first coordinate, forecast before seeing current observations; score every post-burn-in tick including abstentions and budget exhaustion.
comparison: Report all policies at each common energy cap and actual spend. Caps alone are NOT matched spend. Compare frontier points only when comparator uses no more actual mean energy and operations. Paired seed bootstrap, 2000 resamples. No superior-efficiency claim from padded or unmatched budgets.
kill_rule: Keep extra adaptation exception-triggered, with no superiority claim, unless it lowers heldout Brier with paired 95% upper bound below zero against every eligible fixed-focus and real-learner frontier comparator while not increasing false gluing. A fixed-focus frontier point or extra false splits blocks promotion.
hardware: Use perf_counter and process_time. Actual joules null unless independently measured hardware energy is available; simulated metabolic ledger is nonnegative and unrelated to the indefinite determinant form.
claims: No sentience, biology, unique geometric advantage, physical morphology or measured energy-efficiency claim. This finite sensor experiment does not complete the nonorientable-cylinder organism.
